saw_lines: Nobody buys kava on a whim. They want the buzz without the hangover, then they reorder the same bottle.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a buyer reaches the price or the reorder option.
Your site shows 1236 reviews and 100,000+ customers, yet none of your 30 ads use either number. Put 1236 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: Your site says Trusted by 100,000+ customers and shows 1236 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Buyers need that proof before they click. Put 1236 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

Your site advertises subscribe and save at 10% off, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription. Regulars reorder a drink they like, and no ad asks them to. Run two retention ads with the 10% saving as the headline.

Your site shows $47.70 and $53.00 on the homepage, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price. Buyers compare it with wine, and an unpriced ad makes them guess. Lead one ad with the price per bottle beside a glass of wine.
Creator posts run as brand ads

13 of 29 ads are creator posts run from your brand page, so the creators’ own accounts carry none of that paid reach. Whitelist the three strongest posts from each creator account and make three variations of each.

ads_1: Review quotes and the subscription saving lead the next batch of creative
